_comment: Migration contract (FIN-13). Derived from the migration bytes by
tests/test_tuition_migration_contract.py - do not hand-edit; the test re-derives
this list and fails if it drifts.
A CONTENT migration repairs or enriches imported curriculum content. It creates no
table of its own, so on a fresh database - where no content has been imported yet -
it has nothing to act on, and several of them assert absolute content counts that an
empty database can never satisfy. 0094 raised 'Listening 1-20 must contain 80
transcript Parts' and aborted the chain before 1115 was ever reached.
These are NOT skipped. scripts/apply-test-migrations.mjs applies them on the upgrade
path, where the content exists and the assertions must hold, and reports them as
deferred on the fresh-install path so nothing disappears silently.

detectedBy.rule: references a content table AND declares no DDL of its own
